1. Public website

Website visitors bina login ke library ke catalog aur services browse karte hain.

PageRouteUse
Home/Hero search, seat CTA, facilities, metrics, how-it-works, featured books, membership plans, categories, articles, gallery, testimonials, newsletter, FAQ and final CTA.
Books/books/Live search, browse/filter catalog, open book cards and discover availability.
Book detail/books/{slug}/Cover, author, description, custom attributes, related items and reader reviews.
Category / Tag/category/{slug}/ · /tag/{slug}/Browse a subject or tag collection.
Blog / Article/blog/ · /blog/{slug}/Read guidance posts and study articles.
Pricing / Registration/pricing/ · /register/Compare monthly, quarterly and yearly plans; apply to become a member.
Login / Contact / Pages/login/ · /contact/Student/admin sign in, contact the library, or visit editable CMS pages.

Homepage sections — Appearance se customize

Facilities + StatsServices and public proof metrics (members, books, seats, rating).
How It Works + BooksMember onboarding steps and featured catalog.
Why Choose + PlansBenefits, membership amounts and plan comparisons.
Categories + ArticlesSubject browsing and latest blog posts.
Gallery + TestimonialsLibrary photos and member feedback.
Newsletter + FAQ + CTASubscribe, answer common questions, and send visitors to registration.

Admin → Appearance → Site Identity → Homepage Sections: arrows se order badlein; Show on homepage toggle se hide/show karein; blank title/subtitle ka matlab default copy rehne dena. Special fields Why Choose/Plans aur final CTA ke text/URL ke liye bhi hain.

2. Student portal

Students ek account se profile, dues, seat aur digital library card dekhte hain.

PageRouteHow to use
Dashboard/student/Membership summary, quick actions, dues, issued books.
Digital Card/student/card.phpMember code and QR; verify or print the card.
Fees/student/fees.phpPending/paid fee status, available payment method, proof and receipts.
Seats/student/seats.phpChoose/release an available seat in a zone, when eligible.
Notifications/student/notifications.phpRead library announcements and alerts.
Profile/student/profile.phpUpdate contact and student/ID details.

Mobile layout me bottom navigation Home, Card, Fees, Seats, Alerts, Profile ko ek tap me kholta hai. Seat/online payment rules membership status and payment verification se controlled hain.

4. General Settings — every control

SettingWhat it changes / practical tip
Currency symbolCurrency mark used on fees, plans and receipts (for example ₹).
Late fine / dayDaily overdue fine for returned books. Set your local rule before going live.
RegistrationsOpen allows new public sign-ups; Closed pauses new applications without removing current members.
PWAEnable/disable installable Progressive Web App support.
TimezoneControls date/time rendering and scheduled timestamps; select the library's actual timezone.
Monthly / Quarterly / YearlyMembership prices shown on pricing and registration screens; check all durations before saving.
Items per pagePagination size for lists/catalogs; smaller pages are easier to scan, larger pages reduce page turns.
Pagination URL styleSEO-friendly /page/2/ paths or query-string ?page=2 URLs.
Groq API KeySecret key used by AI Writer. Store privately; never publish or share screenshots of the value.
Groq modelModel identifier sent to Groq; this preview is configured for gpt-oss-120b.
TemperatureLower is more predictable; higher creates more varied drafts. Start near 0.7.
Max tokensUpper limit for generated response length/cost. Raise only when longer drafts are needed.
Media ProviderLocal writes into the app's uploads folder; FreeImageHost stores externally and returns URLs.
FreeImageHost API KeyOptional provider key for API uploads; use your own key, keep private. Local fallback is available.
Homepage Stats: Members, Books, Seats, RatingFour public marketing numbers. Keep them accurate—manual display values should not imply unverified counts.

5. Online Payments — fields and safe setup

Enable only gateways the library has merchant accounts for. Provider secrets are not part of the narration/screenshots.

Gateway / fieldPurpose
Razorpay EnabledShows Razorpay option to students when enabled.
Razorpay Key IDPublic merchant key ID (test keys begin with rzp_test_).
Razorpay Key SecretPrivate signing secret; never expose in page source or recording.
PayU Enabled / EnvironmentTurn provider on and choose Test before Live.
PayU Merchant Key / SaltMerchant identifier and signing salt; both must match the selected environment.
Instamojo Enabled / EnvironmentEnable and pick test or live endpoint mode.
Instamojo API Key / Auth TokenCredentials to create hosted payment links.
Instamojo Webhook SaltVerifies webhook MAC/signature; keep secret and configure with the provider.
Manual UPI EnabledOffers offline/manual UPI payment and admin verification.
UPI ID / Payee nameIdentifier and name displayed to the student payer.
UPI QR image (media ID)Upload the QR in Media Library and enter that image's ID here.
  1. Enter test credentials and enable the gateway.
  2. Make a test payment and confirm server-side verification, fee status and receipt.
  3. Configure callback/webhook settings as the gateway dashboard requests.
  4. Only after verification, switch the environment and keys to Live.

7. SEO, Email, Menus and Backup

SEO settings

FieldUse
Site titleGlobal default title for search and browser tabs.
Meta descriptionDefault search/social summary; write a concise, accurate description.
Default OG image URLImage used when a page is shared without its own social image.
Card layoutsChoose Poster, Classic, Compact, Editorial, Horizontal or Overlay for Global default, Archive, Category, Related items and Homepage.

Email / SMTP

Host is the SMTP server (blank uses PHP mail); Port is supplied by the provider; Encryption is TLS, SSL or None; Username and Password authenticate; From name and From email are what recipients see. Save, then Send Test Email. Templates are listed with variables such as {{name}}, {{email}}, {{site_name}}, {{amount}}, {{member_code}}, {{txn_ref}}, {{title}}, {{message}}.

Menus / Custom Code / Backup

Menus edits navigation; Custom Code is for advanced snippets—test before publishing. Backup & Reset supports database export/restore/maintenance/reset actions. Download a verified backup before restore or destructive reset.

9. Go-live checklist

  1. Change the demo admin password and remove unused demo accounts.
  2. Replace any placeholder contact details, member/seat/book/rating stats and announcement copy.
  3. Add your Groq API key in General Settings; confirm the model is gpt-oss-120b.
  4. Test local image uploads and alt text; configure FreeImageHost only if you use that provider.
  5. Configure SMTP and send a test email.
  6. Test payments with sandbox keys; configure and test webhooks/callback verification before Live.
  7. Create a backup, test restore on a safe copy, and schedule production backups.
  8. Check mobile layout, dark/light theme, SEO titles, OG image, and public policy/contact pages.
For actual deployment, follow the README and provider documentation for the final production environment. The local preview is for walkthrough only.
